verdict.rationale: Vestd is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair capability to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is not even a documented API surface that a sandbox could attach to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
